title: console AI change card: a published object or field whose label was changed in a draft still shows its published label
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRH4UCX1tvddXMS7cq

Filing gate ①: class a, a user-visible wrong label. This is the remainder of #32984 item 5 ("The confirmation card names objects and fields by their labels"), recorded on that card by area o1-E in comment 6930132262 and not filed until now. #32984 closes once both Q1 PRs have merged (#34513, #34539), so this remainder moves to its own card. Dedupe: `useChangeCardLabels`, `change card label draft overlay published`; no open card.

reach: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts` (`useChangeCardLabels`, from PR #34472). It is reached whenever an AI build conversation proposes a change to an object or field that is already published and whose label the same draft changes.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:ui`

## 维护者速读

- 现象：AI 搭建对话里的确认卡，对「已发布、但草稿里改了标签」的对象或字段，仍显示发布版的旧标签。
- 原因：确认卡先查已发布的元数据，查到就不再看草稿。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What happens

PR #34472 names objects and fields on the change card by label. It reads the published registry by name first and the draft overlay only for a name the registry does not know. When a PUBLISHED object or field has a label that a draft changed, the registry answers first, so the card shows the published label rather than the one the change will publish.

## Change

When a name is in the published registry, also read the draft overlay for it, and show the draft label when the overlay has one. Keep the cost bounded the way #34472 bounds the overlay read now: at most one overlay read per object per conversation revision, none while one is in flight, never per render. #34472 left this out because it costs one more request per object. Measure that cost and say what it is.

Pin: a published object whose draft renames it, and a published field whose draft relabels it, each show the draft label on the card. A published name with no draft change still shows its published label (control).

## Done when

The change card shows a draft-changed label for published objects and fields, and the pins pass.
